finding.claim: The plan gives the root tests/ its own small conftest with the autouse fixtures its tests still need (the per-run uv cache, KMCTL_PINNED). None was added. _uv_cache now lives only in packages/kmctl/tests/conftest.py, so the root integration tests that run uv (tests/scripts/test_check_wheel.py package_build, test_smoke_wheel.py, test_release.py's _build) write to the shared uv cache whenever they run without a kmctl test in the same session, which is the growth that fixture exists to stop.

fixes.change: New conftest for the root tests with the session-wide per-run uv cache fixture, so root tests that start uv no longer write to the shared cache when run without kmctl's tests.
